# 9.09 Two vector operations against one fused kernel: the global loads and stores, counted
Part: two vector operations in two kernels against one fused kernel: the global loads and stores, counted
Clause: CUDA C++ Best Practices Guide §9.1 Data transfer between host and device, CUDA C++ Best Practices Guide §9.2 Device memory spaces, PMPP 5th ed. §5.1 Memory bandwidth as a performance limiter, PMPP 5th ed. §11.9 Consolidating block segments for a global scan (the global accesses of separate kernels), PMPP 5th ed. §20.3 Implementing attention in CUDA (a fused kernel)
After: 9.01
Levels: c++23
Device: yes
Source: CUDA C++ Best Practices Guide ch. 9; Programming Massively Parallel Processors, 5th ed. (Hwu, Kirk, El Hajj), ch. 5, §5.1, ch. 11, §11.9, and ch. 20, §20.3

## Example
```cuda
#include <print>

//: Count the loads and stores of global memory.
__managed__ unsigned loads;
__managed__ unsigned stores;

struct Field {
    int* p;
    __device__ int load(int i) const
    {
        atomicAdd(&loads, 1u);
        return p[i];
    }
    __device__ void store(int i, int v) const
    {
        atomicAdd(&stores, 1u);
        p[i] = v;
    }
};

//: Fuse t = x + y and z = t * w: t stays in a register.
__global__ void fused(Field x, Field y, Field w, Field z)
{
    int i {static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)};
    int t {x.load(i) + y.load(i)};
    z.store(i, t * w.load(i));
}

int main()
{
    int* a {nullptr};
    cudaMallocManaged(&a, 32 * sizeof(int));
    for (int i {0}; i < 32; ++i) {
        a[i] = 2;
    }
    //: Run 8 elements: 24 loads and 8 stores, not 32 and 16.
    fused<<<1, 8>>>(Field {a}, Field {a + 8}, Field {a + 16},
                    Field {a + 24});
    cudaDeviceSynchronize();
    std::println("{} {} {}", a[24], loads, stores);
    cudaFree(a);
}
```

## Verdict 1
```cuda
#include <print>

__global__ void add(const int* x, int* t)
{
    int i {static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x * 64 + threadIdx.x)};
    t[i] = x[i] + 1;
}

__global__ void pair(const int* t, int* z)
{
    int i {static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x * 64 + threadIdx.x)};
    z[i] = i + 1 < 256 ? t[i] + t[i + 1] : t[i];
}

int main()
{
    int* x {nullptr};
    int* t {nullptr};
    int* z {nullptr};
    cudaMallocManaged(&x, 256 * sizeof(int));
    cudaMallocManaged(&t, 256 * sizeof(int));
    cudaMallocManaged(&z, 256 * sizeof(int));
    for (int i {0}; i < 256; ++i) {
        x[i] = i;
    }
    add<<<4, 64>>>(x, t);
    pair<<<4, 64>>>(t, z);
    cudaDeviceSynchronize();
    std::println("{}", z[63]);
    cudaFree(x);
    cudaFree(t);
    cudaFree(z);
}
```
Answer: c++23 defined

## Verdict 2
Sanitizer: racecheck
```cuda
#include <print>

__global__ void fused(const int* x, int* z)
{
    __shared__ int t[64];
    int k {static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)};
    t[k] = x[k] + 1;
    z[k] = k + 1 < 64 ? t[k] + t[k + 1] : t[k];
}

int main()
{
    int* x {nullptr};
    int* z {nullptr};
    cudaMallocManaged(&x, 64 * sizeof(int));
    cudaMallocManaged(&z, 64 * sizeof(int));
    for (int i {0}; i < 64; ++i) {
        x[i] = i;
    }
    fused<<<1, 64>>>(x, z);
    cudaDeviceSynchronize();
    std::println("{}", z[31]);
    cudaFree(x);
    cudaFree(z);
}
```
Answer: c++23 undefined sanitizer

## Count
Columns: loads, stores
```cuda
#include <print>

__managed__ unsigned tally[64][2];

struct Field {
    int* p;
    __device__ int load(int i, int at = __builtin_LINE()) const
    {
        atomicAdd(&tally[at][0], 1u);
        return p[i];
    }
    __device__ void store(int i, int v,
                          int at = __builtin_LINE())
    {
        atomicAdd(&tally[at][1], 1u);
        p[i] = v;
    }
};

__global__ void two(Field x, Field y, Field w, Field t, Field z)
{
    int i {static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)};
    t.store(i, x.load(i) + y.load(i));
}

__global__ void second(Field t, Field w, Field z)
{
    int i {static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)};
    z.store(i, t.load(i) * w.load(i));
}

__global__ void fused(Field x, Field y, Field w, Field z)
{
    int i {static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)};
    z.store(i, (x.load(i) + y.load(i)) * w.load(i));
}

int main()
{
    int* a {nullptr};
    cudaMallocManaged(&a, 40 * sizeof(int));
    Field x {a};
    Field y {a + 8};
    Field w {a + 16};
    Field t {a + 24};
    Field z {a + 32};
    two<<<1, 8>>>(x, y, w, t, z);
    second<<<1, 8>>>(t, w, z);
    fused<<<1, 8>>>(x, y, w, z);
    cudaDeviceSynchronize();
    for (int line {0}; line < 64; ++line) {
        for (unsigned k {0}; k < tally[line][0]; ++k) {
            std::println("@{} loads", line);
        }
        for (unsigned k {0}; k < tally[line][1]; ++k) {
            std::println("@{} stores", line);
        }
    }
    cudaFree(a);
}
```

## Alone 1
Form: run
Write a program that reads n integers x and n integers y, and computes z on the device in two ways. Let t = x + y. Then z[i] = t[i] when t[i] ≥ 0, and z[i] = y[i] otherwise. First, use two kernels: one stores t, and one reads t back and stores z. Second, use one fused kernel that stores only z. A kernel loads a value only when it needs it, and each value at most once. Count every load and store of global memory, for each way.
Input: one line, n, then one line of n integers x, then one line of n integers y.
Output: three lines: the n values of z separated by spaces; the loads and the stores of the two kernels together; the loads and the stores of the fused kernel.
Limits: 1 ≤ n ≤ 4096; each integer is between -1000 and 1000.
### Examples
```in
3
1 2 3
4 5 6
```
```out
5 7 9
9 6
6 3
```
```in
4
5 -2 0 7
-1 3 3 -4
```
```out
4 1 3 3
12 8
8 4
```
### Reference
```cuda
#include <iostream>
#include <print>

__managed__ unsigned loads;
__managed__ unsigned stores;

struct Field {
    int* p;
    __device__ int load(int i) const
    {
        atomicAdd(&loads, 1u);
        return p[i];
    }
    __device__ void store(int i, int v) const
    {
        atomicAdd(&stores, 1u);
        p[i] = v;
    }
};

__global__ void add(Field x, Field y, Field t, int n)
{
    int i {static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x * blockDim.x
            + threadIdx.x)};
    if (i < n) {
        t.store(i, x.load(i) + y.load(i));
    }
}

__global__ void pick(Field t, Field y, Field z, int n)
{
    int i {static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x * blockDim.x
            + threadIdx.x)};
    if (i < n) {
        int v {t.load(i)};
        z.store(i, v >= 0 ? v : y.load(i));
    }
}

__global__ void fused(Field x, Field y, Field z, int n)
{
    int i {static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x * blockDim.x
            + threadIdx.x)};
    if (i < n) {
        int b {y.load(i)};
        int v {x.load(i) + b};
        z.store(i, v >= 0 ? v : b);
    }
}

int main()
{
    int n {0};
    std::cin >> n;
    int* a[5] {};
    for (int*& p : a) {
        cudaMallocManaged(&p, n * sizeof(int));
    }
    Field x {a[0]};
    Field y {a[1]};
    Field t {a[2]};
    Field z {a[3]};
    Field z2 {a[4]};
    for (int i {0}; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> x.p[i];
    }
    for (int i {0}; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> y.p[i];
    }
    int g {(n + 255) / 256};
    add<<<g, 256>>>(x, y, t, n);
    pick<<<g, 256>>>(t, y, z, n);
    cudaDeviceSynchronize();
    unsigned two[2] {loads, stores};
    loads = 0;
    stores = 0;
    fused<<<g, 256>>>(x, y, z2, n);
    cudaDeviceSynchronize();
    for (int i {0}; i < n; ++i) {
        std::print("{}{}", i == 0 ? "" : " ", z2.p[i]);
    }
    std::println();
    std::println("{} {}", two[0], two[1]);
    std::println("{} {}", loads, stores);
    for (int* p : a) {
        cudaFree(p);
    }
}
```

## Alone 2
Form: run
Write a program that reads n integers x and n integers y, and replaces y on the device in two ways. First set y[i] = x[i] + y[i]; then set y[i] = 0 where y[i] < 0. First, use two kernels: one stores the sums into y, and one loads y and stores 0 only where the value is below 0. Second, use one fused kernel that stores each y[i] once. Each way starts from the y that was read. Count every load and store of global memory, for each way.
Input: one line, n, then one line of n integers x, then one line of n integers y.
Output: three lines: the n final values of y separated by spaces; the loads and the stores of the two kernels together; the loads and the stores of the fused kernel.
Limits: 1 ≤ n ≤ 4096; each integer is between -1000 and 1000.
### Examples
```in
3
1 2 3
4 5 6
```
```out
5 7 9
9 3
6 3
```
```in
4
5 -2 0 7
-1 3 3 4
```
```out
4 1 3 11
12 4
8 4
```
### Reference
```cuda
#include <iostream>
#include <print>

__managed__ unsigned loads;
__managed__ unsigned stores;

struct Field {
    int* p;
    __device__ int load(int i) const
    {
        atomicAdd(&loads, 1u);
        return p[i];
    }
    __device__ void store(int i, int v) const
    {
        atomicAdd(&stores, 1u);
        p[i] = v;
    }
};

__global__ void add(Field x, Field y, int n)
{
    int i {static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x * blockDim.x
            + threadIdx.x)};
    if (i < n) {
        y.store(i, x.load(i) + y.load(i));
    }
}

__global__ void clamp(Field y, int n)
{
    int i {static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x * blockDim.x
            + threadIdx.x)};
    if (i < n && y.load(i) < 0) {
        y.store(i, 0);
    }
}

__global__ void fused(Field x, Field y, int n)
{
    int i {static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x * blockDim.x
            + threadIdx.x)};
    if (i < n) {
        int v {x.load(i) + y.load(i)};
        y.store(i, v < 0 ? 0 : v);
    }
}

int main()
{
    int n {0};
    std::cin >> n;
    int* a[3] {};
    for (int*& p : a) {
        cudaMallocManaged(&p, n * sizeof(int));
    }
    Field x {a[0]};
    Field y {a[1]};
    Field y2 {a[2]};
    for (int i {0}; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> x.p[i];
    }
    for (int i {0}; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> y.p[i];
        y2.p[i] = y.p[i];
    }
    int g {(n + 255) / 256};
    add<<<g, 256>>>(x, y, n);
    clamp<<<g, 256>>>(y, n);
    cudaDeviceSynchronize();
    unsigned two[2] {loads, stores};
    loads = 0;
    stores = 0;
    fused<<<g, 256>>>(x, y2, n);
    cudaDeviceSynchronize();
    for (int i {0}; i < n; ++i) {
        std::print("{}{}", i == 0 ? "" : " ", y2.p[i]);
    }
    std::println();
    std::println("{} {}", two[0], two[1]);
    std::println("{} {}", loads, stores);
    for (int* p : a) {
        cudaFree(p);
    }
}
```
